actual_request.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept game animation sprite. Make ONE completely rendered new full-body frame, native square at least 1024x1024, actual transparent RGBA alpha. Image1 is the EDIT TARGET: preserve its exact camera, face, head and body proportions, all hair, jade green/ivory/gold clothing and long bamboo bow shape/held height, right-shoulder quiver. Image2 is original identity, image3 is PRIMARY STYLE reference, retain their clean rounded bright hand-painted look. No added objects, no text, no ground/shadow. Keep entire figure/equipment inside margins. Bow stays relaxed in anatomical LEFT hand at middle grip, right hand free, no arrow nocked. Change ONLY walking limb articulation/necessary garment folds as described. Frame the body exactly as image1. Redraw requested pose; do not just duplicate its pose. NORTHEAST rear-right three-quarter view unchanged. Independent neutral standing idle: BOTH boots soles resting quietly on same ground plane with weight evenly distributed, feet about pelvis-width apart and knees softly straight, no stride, no airborne boot, no raised sole. Arms relaxed, LEFT hand carries bow vertically off ground same height; RIGHT hand relaxed at side. Hair and ribbons settle naturally. This is a separately drawn standing sprite, no walking pose. No yin-yang buckle on back.
